note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge) after the row moved to {gap} under the owner ruling that RTR version 0 is owed. RFC 6810 Section 7 reads 'Caches and routers MUST implement unprotected transport over TCP using a port, rpki-rtr (323); see Section 12.' The transport is the carrier of the version 0 protocol this document defines, and Ze carries no version 0 session over it: Ze dials unprotected TCP on port 323, but internal/component/bgp/plugins/rpki/rtr_session.go::RTRSession.handlePDU returns errRtrUnsupportedProtocol for every PDU but a Serial Notify or Error Report whose version is below rtrVersionMin = 1 and refuses a cache's Error Report code 4 that offers such a version, and RTRSession.syncOnce never downgrades below rtrVersionMin. The unprotected TCP transport is proven for versions 1 and 2 under RFC8210-9-1 by tests that no longer carry this id. With no version 0 session, a version 0 cache gets no usable transport from Ze, so the requirement is unmet.
